title: SNAr of 4-fluoronitrobenzene with piperazine
protocol: 4-Fluoronitrobenzene (1.00 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and piperazine (1.20 mmol, 1.2 equiv) were dissolved in DMF to give a substrate concentration of 0.30 M. The mixture was heated at 120 C under air for 6 h. Standard aqueous workup and purification gave the arylated piperazine product in 81% isolated yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Knoevenagel condensation over N-doped carbon
protocol: Benzaldehyde (5.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and malononitrile (5.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) were combined with an N-doped carbon heterogeneous basic catalyst in acetonitrile. The suspension was heated at 50 C for 24 h in a 25 mL round-bottom flask. The 2-benzylidenemalononitrile product was obtained in 85% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Copper-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition
protocol: An equimolar mixture of benzyl azide and phenylacetylene was prepared in acetone at 0.25 M with copper-in-charcoal (Cu/C, 10 mol%). The mixture was heated by microwave irradiation at 150 C for 3 min. The 1,4-substituted 1,2,3-triazole was isolated in 94% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Suzuki-Miyaura cross-coupling
protocol: An aromatic bromide (1.6 mmol, 1.0 equiv), a phenylboronic acid derivative, base, and a palladium catalyst were combined in DMF. The mixture was irradiated in a 50 W microwave reactor at 50 C for 10 min. The biaryl product was obtained in 91% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Photocatalytic aerobic oxidation of Fmoc-L-methionine
protocol: Fmoc-L-methionine (3.7 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) were dissolved in acetonitrile at 0.10 M in a round-bottom flask. The solution was exposed to air and irradiated with a 1.5 W LED centered near 420 nm at 21 C for 5 min. Fmoc-methionine sulfoxide was formed in 99% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Photochemical benzylic bromination with NBS
protocol: Methyl N,N-bis(tert-butoxycarbonyl)-L-phenylalaninate (1.0 equiv) and N-bromosuccinimide (2.0 equiv) were dissolved in carbon tetrachloride. The solution was irradiated with UV light at 30 C for 8 h. The corresponding beta-brominated product was obtained in 70% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Hydrogenolysis of N-diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol
protocol: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol was dissolved in methanol and contacted with hydrogen over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 at 60 C in a batch hydrogenation reactor for 5 h. Acetic acid may be used to enhance the reaction rate. The 3-azetidinol product was obtained in 38.1% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Palladium-catalyzed dioxygenation of alkenes
protocol: An alkene (0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv), PhI(OAc)2 (1.2 equiv), and a tridentate palladium complex immobilized on magnetic particles (3.5 mol%) were combined in DMF/AcOH (1:2) under nitrogen. The mixture was stirred at 20 C for 5 h to give the dioxygenated alkene in 86% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: One-step dinitration of an aniline derivative
protocol: An aniline derivative was treated with nitric acid in the industrial batch solvent at 60 C for 4 h. Nitric acid served as nitrating reagent and acid catalyst. The dinitrated product was obtained in 89% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: tert-Butyl peroxypivalate synthesis
protocol: Aqueous tert-butyl hydroperoxide was converted to potassium tert-butylperoxide with KOH (1.12 equiv), then reacted with pivaloyl chloride in the presence of sodium dodecyl sulfate. The biphasic exothermic reaction was run in a three-necked flask at 23 C for 31 min and afforded tert-butyl peroxypivalate in 53% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Two-step oxidative amidation of benzyl alcohol
protocol: Benzyl alcohol and morpholine were used in a 1:1 ratio in dioxane at 0.667 M. TBHP was the oxidant, with NaBr and sulfuric acid promoting oxidation and amidation. The two-step batch sequence was operated at 80 C for a total of 30 min and afforded benzoyl morpholine in 76% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Multistep synthesis sequence toward dolutegravir
protocol: The first operation of a seven-step sequence combined methyl 4-methoxyacetoacetate (2.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) with dimethylformamide dimethylacetal (1.6 equiv) in acetic acid at 0.20 M. The batch operation was heated at 80 C for 60 min and furnished the vinylogous amide intermediate in 96% yield. The requested design objective is an integrated, staged continuous process through the reported dolutegravir sequence, with explicit residence time and additions for every stage.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Oxygen-fed photochemical oxidation
protocol: A 0.20 M acetonitrile solution of substrate and 1 mol% photocatalyst is irradiated at 450 nm under 2.0 equivalents of oxygen at 40 C for 2 h in batch. Convert this to flow and report oxygen flow at inlet/STP and pressure-corrected in-channel conditions separately.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Hydrogenation over a packed bed
protocol: A 0.10 M ethanol solution of an alkene is hydrogenated over 5 wt% Pd/C at 50 C and 10 bar hydrogen for 4 h in batch. Design a continuous packed-bed process with gas-liquid mixing, catalyst retention, pressure control, and startup/shutdown safeguards.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Ozonolysis with immediate reductive quench
protocol: A 0.05 M solution of an alkene in dichloromethane is treated with ozone at -20 C until consumption, followed immediately by dimethyl sulfide quench. Propose a continuous process that minimizes ozone and ozonide inventory.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Chlorine addition with inline quench
protocol: An alkene solution at 0.20 M is exposed to 1.05 equivalents of chlorine gas at 0 C for 30 min in batch, then quenched with aqueous sodium thiosulfate. Translate to flow with explicit gas dosing and off-gas handling.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Carbon monoxide carbonylation
protocol: An aryl halide at 0.10 M is carbonylated using palladium catalyst, base, and carbon monoxide at 15 bar and 100 C for 3 h in batch. Design a continuous gas-liquid process with explicit CO containment and monitoring.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Fast exothermic neutralization
protocol: A 1.0 M organic acid stream and a 1.0 M sodium hydroxide stream are mixed at equal molar flow. Batch calorimetry indicates an adiabatic temperature rise of 55 C and completion in less than 2 s. Design a temperature-controlled continuous process.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Salt-forming coupling with precipitation risk
protocol: An aryl halide and amine are coupled in the presence of inorganic base in a 0.50 M solvent system at 100 C for 8 h. Substantial inorganic salt precipitation is observed during batch operation. Design a robust continuous process.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.

title: Two-stage sequence with incompatible feeds
protocol: Stage 1 oxidizes an alcohol with an organic peroxide at 40 C for 20 min. The resulting aldehyde must then be mixed with an amine, but direct contact of the amine with the peroxide feed is prohibited. Stage 2 proceeds at 80 C for 45 min. Design a continuous sequence with explicit delayed addition and residence time for each stage.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.
